name: Missing Loop Movement to Mouse
hint: The finder detects mouse-dependent motion or direction code that runs once outside a loop. It uses the mouse position only at that moment, so later pointer movement is not followed and the actor can appear to stop responding.
instruction: Put all mouse-dependent motion or direction updates in a suitable repeating loop, and include a small wait when necessary so the project remains responsive.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
set x to (mouse x)

examples.label: Possible solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
forever
set x to (mouse x)
end
